description: This Java class 'EspetaculosController' is a web controller managing theater or event shows, including listing, adding, and reserving sessions, as well as creating show sessions.

classes.name: EspetaculosController
classes.description: Controller class for managing theater shows and sessions, handling HTTP requests for listing, adding, reserving, and creating sessions.

methods.name: lista
methods.description: Returns a list of all espetaculos and includes establishments in the result.

methods.name: adiciona
methods.description: Adds a new espetaculo after validating its name and description.

methods.name: sessao
methods.description: Displays details of a specific session by ID.

methods.name: reserva
methods.description: Reserves tickets for a session, validating availability and input.

methods.name: sessoes
methods.description: Displays sessions for a specific espetaculo.

methods.name: cadastraSessoes
methods.description: Creates multiple sessions for an espetaculo based on input dates, time, and periodicity.

methods.name: carregaEspetaculo
methods.description: Loads an espetaculo by ID, handling not found errors.

methods.name: criaEstabelecimento
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an establishment, currently returning the first from the list.
